    """Arrange the four quarter-turns of the input in a 2x2 block."""
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]

    output = []

        output.append(list(original_row) + list(clockwise_row))
    for counter_row, half_row in zip(counterclockwise, half_turn):
        output.append(list(counter_row) + list(half_row))
    return output
